items.name: Smart Hospital Edge AI on FPGA
items.summary: Real-time ECG anomaly detection: a 1D CNN trained on MIT-BIH, quantized to INT8 (4× smaller), and run as Verilog RTL on a Xilinx Zynq-7020 with an FSM-based inference engine at 100 MHz. Fully on-device and privacy-focused.
